contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ NERO CLAVD CAESAR AVG GER[M PM ---]PPP ; R/ PACE P R TERRA M[ARI]Q PARTA IANVM CLVSIT

Copper alloy coin. Sestertius of Nero (54-68), mint of Rome issue of AD 63-68, in unusually good condition; the finder notes that exceptionally deep ploughing had taken place in the area of this find. RIC vol. 1 page 156 no. 167; note refers to die-sinking errors in the context of the obverse legends. Obverse description: Bust laureate left, tousled hair and thick neck. Obverse inscription: NERO…
